name: vblank_handler
notes: every vertical blank (60 a second); lets the main loop run a frame every 2 (every 1 with the 60 fps code)

name: main_loop
notes: one frame: updates every subsystem, then end_of_frame, then Game.frame_count += 1

name: user_main
notes: the user_main thread: sets its own priority to 48 (the DATA.BIN loader's), then main_loop for good

name: main_init
notes: before the first frame: keeps this thread in Game.main_thread, starts the priority changer and the CheckExitGame thread (priority 111)

name: priority_changer_start
notes: starts the priorityChanger thread (priority 40)

name: priority_changer_thread
notes: sleeps; woken while GameData.game_flags has 0x200, it raises the main thread to 38 (and Game.second_thread to 39), above the loader

name: priority_changer_lower
notes: the main thread back to 48 (Game.second_thread to 49), then wakes the priority changer

name: priority_changer_create_timer
notes: creates the "ChangeThreadVTimer"

name: priority_changer_arm
notes: starts the VTimer; vblank_handler calls it when it lets the main loop run a frame

name: priority_changer_timer
notes: the VTimer's handler: priority_changer_lower, once more 16.7 ms later, then stops

name: end_of_frame
notes: the last call of the main loop each frame

name: renderer_begin_frame
notes: resets the frame's draw lists; +0x15e counts frames

name: hunter_request_motion
signature: void hunter_request_motion(Hunter* hunter, s16 motion, s32 blend, s16 flags)
notes: asks for a motion (and motion + 100 for the upper body), blending over blend / 2 frames; hunter_motion_update starts it

name: hunter_motion_update
notes: sets the motion speed (2.0, at 0x088D5DF8: the 60 fps code makes it 1.0) and starts the motions asked for

name: motion_start
signature: void motion_start(Motion* motion, void* data, s32 frame, s32 blend, s32 layer)
notes: starts a motion on a layer at a frame, blending in over blend + 1 frames (blend_rate 1 / (blend + 1) a frame; under 0: the other way)

name: character_in_action
signature: s32 character_in_action(Character* character, s8 group, s8 id)
notes: whether its current action is (group, id)

name: hunter_read_pad
notes: copies the pad into Hunter.pad_held, pad_pressed and pad_released each frame; nothing while a message waits

name: quest_gather_points
notes: the area's gather points, ending with a position x of -1.0 (null if none)

name: character_update
notes: unless paused: action_time += 2, held_time += 2, countdown -= 1, then the class's update (method 0x3c)

name: pad_read
notes: reads the pad (buttons, and the stick as a direction in the high 16 bits) into pad_held, pad_pressed, pad_released and pad_repeat: held buttons repeat after 13 frames, then every 3

name: play_time_update
notes: frame_count += 1; play_time += 1 every 30 frames

name: message_type_out
signature: s32 message_type_out(MessageWindow* window, char* text, u32 frames, s32 mode, s32 choice)
notes: shows a message up to where it has typed out: 3 frames a letter, 15 after . ? and 8 after a comma; frames is the time since it started (-1: all of it)

name: message_draw
notes: draws the typed-out letters

name: message_show_system
signature: void message_show_system(MessageWindow* window, s32 a, s32 message, s32 b)
notes: a system message such as an item's effect wearing off

name: sound_play
notes: plays a sound effect

name: sound_frame
notes: runs the sound command queue; counts frames at 0x09A0B56C

name: sas_render_thread
notes: the CsePspSasRendThread (priority 17): updates the 32 voices, mixes a block with sas_core, adds effects, and outputs it (blocking)

name: sound_voices_update
notes: sound_voice_update on each of the 32 voices (0x2c bytes each from 0x09A0E3CC)

name: sound_voice_update
notes: applies the changes flagged in a voice's +0xc, one bit at a time from bit 0 (4 pitch, 0x400 volume, 0x800 envelope, 0x4000 key on, 0x8000 key off); loops forever if a bit it has passed is set meanwhile

name: sas_core
notes: __sceSasCore on the sound engine's SAS core; 0x80420005 for a buffer not 64-byte aligned

name: audio_output
signature: s32 audio_output(u32 channel, u32 left, u32 right, void* buffer)
notes: sceAudioOutputPannedBlocking on one of 4 reserved channels

name: stage_update
notes: an area's effects: effect_count += 1, effect_turn += 0x2e, effect_timer, then the stage's own update (method 0x20)

name: field_camera_update
notes: the hunting areas' camera; the d-pad turns it (the recomp's right-stick camera replaces it)

name: field_camera_read_pad
notes: copies CameraManager.held_buttons and pressed_buttons into buttons_used and pressed_used while it takes the pad (field_camera_takes_pad, and camera 5 not running); otherwise L alone, or nothing

name: field_camera_takes_pad
notes: whether the d-pad turns the camera: not while a message or the menu is up, nor in some of the hunter's actions

name: field_camera_should_recenter
notes: whether the camera turns back behind the hunter this frame: L tapped (hunter_tapped_l), and in some actions

name: village_camera_update
notes: the village's and the house's camera

name: aim_camera_update
notes: the camera over the shoulder when aiming

name: event_camera_update
notes: starts a cutscene camera asked for (CameraManager.event_request), runs it as a script or a track

name: event_camera_run_script
notes: runs commands up to the next frame: 0x26 starts a step of N frames, 0x27 places the camera and counts the step down

name: event_camera_place
notes: places the camera between two keys by step_left / step_length

name: event_camera_track_update
notes: loads a track of keys, then each frame places the camera on it and step_left += 1

name: event_camera_place_on_track
notes: between the keys around step_left * 2; true at the end

name: quest_time
notes: 1: the time limit, 0: the time left (frames)

name: hunt_task_frame
notes: frames += 1, play_time_update, then resumes the task

name: task_resume
notes: resumes the task's coroutine for a frame

name: coroutine_switch
notes: saves this context, restores another (used by tasks)

name: hunter_countdowns
notes: timer_62c, timer_46a, timer_630, timer_5f0 -= 1

name: memset
signature: void* memset(void* to, s32 value, u32 size)

name: memcpy_words
notes: copies memory

name: debug_print
notes: prints a debug line (format)

# module: # --- game_sub.ovl (loaded at 0x09C19000 in the village and on hunts) ---

name: collision_sweep_sphere
notes: sweeps a sphere (radius in $f12) through the world (a0) from a1 to a2, writing where it stops to a3; flags in t0; non-zero on a hit

name: collision_floor_height
notes: the height of the floor under a point (a1) in the world (a0), in $f0

name: texture_animation_update
notes: frame_u and frame_v += 1

name: marker_update
notes: the marker bobbing over a character

name: hunt_flipbook_update
notes: frame and frame2 += 1, wrapping

name: lobby_task_update
notes: a frame of the village's state machine; some states wait by counting wait down

name: lobby_task_common
notes: what the village does every frame, whatever its state

name: villager_update
notes: as character_update, and a count to 100 at +0x4ec

name: villager_motion_update
notes: frames in the current motion at +0x4fc

name: lobby_flipbook_update
notes: frame += 1, wrapping

name: elder_talk
notes: the Village Elder's dialog

name: npc_talk_update
notes: a frame of an NPC's dialog: time since the message started += 1, message_type_out

name: hunt_task_main
notes: the hunt task's coroutine

name: hunt_task_states
notes: the hunt's state machine: fades, loading an area (sets GameData.area)...

name: hunter_frame
notes: a hunter's frame on hunts: character_update, hunter_update, then its actions

name: hunter_update
notes: the hunter's update on hunts

name: hunter_tapped_l
notes: L let go after being held under 10 frames (Hunter.l_held_frames): the camera turns back behind the hunter; held longer, L only shows the item bar

name: hunter_run_action
notes: runs the current action, by Character.action_group (group 0: hunter_actions_0)

name: hunter_actions_0
notes: group 0 actions, by Character.action_id

name: hunter_set_action
signature: void hunter_set_action(Hunter* hunter, s8 group, s8 id, s32 flags)
notes: starts an action (through the hunter's method 0x6c)

name: hunter_sheathed_input
notes: what the buttons do with the weapon sheathed, standing, walking or running: Circle interacts (hunter_interact, hunter_try_gather), Square uses an item (hunter_try_gather with how 2 first)

name: hunter_interact
notes: acts on the area spot the hunter stands in (stage_spot_at): fishing, quest spots and others

name: stage_spot_at
signature: s16 stage_spot_at(Hunter* hunter, vec3* position, s16* parameter, u8* kind)
notes: the type of the area spot the hunter stands in (0x18 to 0x23; hunter_frame shows a prompt for 0x18, 0x1e and 0x21), 0 if none

name: hunter_try_gather
notes: at a gather point (gather_point_at): how 0 (Circle) gathers (action 0x47), how 2 (Square) mines (0x51) or catches bugs (0x52) with the right tool selected

name: gather_point_at
signature: s16 gather_point_at(Hunter* hunter, s16* kind, vec3* position)
notes: the table of the gather point the hunter stands at, and its kind; -1 if none

name: hunter_gather_action
notes: gathering actions (0 gather, 4 mine, 5 catch bugs, 2 quest items): the motion, gather_item when action_timer runs out, then back to standing

name: gather_item
notes: rolls the item (gather_roll) and puts it in the pouch, with the messages; -1 if nothing

name: gather_roll
notes: the item from the gather point the hunter stands at, counting its gathers down: 0 none, -2 nothing left

name: hunter_update_timers
notes: counts the hunter's timers down (items, ailments, hunger), recovers health every 60 frames, stamina

name: hunter_update_hunger
notes: hunger -= 1 to 6 a frame (area, skills); at 0 the most stamina drops

name: hunter_add_stamina
notes: the 60 fps code makes changes under 4 apply every other call

name: hunter_use_stamina
notes: with skills, then hunter_add_stamina

name: monster_frame
notes: by update_state: monster_appear, monster_update, monster_die...

name: monster_update
notes: a live monster's frame: character_update (and its species' code), its timers, ailments, rage, motion, collision

name: monster_move_facing
notes: position += speed turned to the monster's facing (x and z; y as it is)

name: monster_move_facing_2
notes: the same as monster_move_facing

name: monster_timed_moves
notes: an action of steps timed by action_timer (190, 254, 182, 121... frames), some moving by speed

name: monster_flying_action
signature: void monster_flying_action(Monster* monster, s32 a, s32 b)
notes: position += speed, speed += acceleration, until near the floor

name: monster_sliding_action
notes: slides by speed while action_timer counts down, then waits

name: monster_update_hate
notes: hate towards each player wears off

name: monster_fall
notes: speed += acceleration, position += speed, then onto the floor; true when it lands
